description:
Get exclusive videos & early access on my Patreon: http://patreon.com/RyanGeorge

I spent way too long on Threads so I could document the very specific types of guys who live there, and I have findings.

Threads is Meta's answer to Twitter, and it turns out it's also accidentally the world's greatest social experiment in men behaving strangely on the internet. We've got vague posting, spoiler text being used for absolutely no reason, reply guys hitting on fake profiles, AI profiles, celebrity profiles, and one very prolific gentleman who has made "gorgeous beautiful stunning lady" his entire personality. Also the women replying to Shemar Moore are not innocent in all of this. I looked into it. I have a doctor's note that says I didn't have to log into LinkedIn for the last video, but unfortunately no such note exists for Threads. I did this for you.
